name: tRNA
oneLine: An adapter: one end reads a codon, the other carries an amino acid.
howItWorks: Each tRNA has three letters that match one codon. On its other end sits the matching amino acid. It delivers that amino acid to the ribosome.
deeper: tRNA is about 76 letters folded into an L shape. Dedicated enzymes load each one with the right amino acid.
sizeComparison: a 15,000th the width of a hair
simplification: Each tRNA type gets one colour. Real ones look nearly identical.
